newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ericsson started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ericsson started as hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it has started coverage of telecommunications equipment firm Ericsson Telecomunicacoes SA, the Brazilian unit of Swedish giant Telefon AB L M Ericsson, with a hold recommendation.
-- "We think share prices are fairly valued relative to the market," the Dutch investment bank said in a report.
-- Ericsson's market share is 41 percent in wireline and 36 percent in wireless equipment and its investments in Brazil's telecoms sector are expected to grow 45 percent this year, it said.
-- The bank said it has set a 12-month price target for Ericsson of $28 per 1,000 shares and calculates the price target based on the discounted cash flow method at a 15-percent discount rate.
-- "We value Ericsson at $1.18 billion, indicating potential appreciation of 38.6 percent in relation to current market value," it said.
-- ING said investments by state telecoms giant are about to jump to 8.0 billion reais a year between 1996 and 2003, compared with 3.0 billion annually from 1990-1995.
-- Ericsson's already large backlog of orders will rise by 50 percent based on planned Telebras and B Band cellular investments, it added.
-- "The big issue for Ericsson is which cellular digital technology Telebras will adopt: TDMA technology supplied by Ericsson or CDMA used by NEC (Corp ) and Motorola (Inc )," it said.
-- Its preferred stock was up 0.05 reais at 22.70 reais while its voting common rose 0.27 reais to 22.50 reais at 1722 local/1922 GMT on the Sao Paulo exchange.
